modmenu.summaryTranslation.autoominousbo: Drinks an Ominous Bottle after every raid. For AFK raid farms.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.autoomino: Drinks an Ominous Bottle after every raid, eats when hungry, can jump until the raid starts and counts won raids. For AFK raid farms.
autoominousbottle.config.title: Auto Ominous Bottle settings
autoominousbottle.config.auto_jump.tip: Jump while you have an omen and the raid has not started yet. For farms where the raid will not start without jumping.
autoominousbottle.config.drink_delay.tip: Wait after a raid: how long there must be no raid bar and no omen before drinking the next bottle.
The key turns the mod on only with a second press within 3 seconds. Turning off is always instant.
autoominousbottle.config.auto_disable.ti: Turn the mod off after rejoining, changing dimension or dying.
autoominousbottle.msg.confirm: Press %s again to turn on Auto Ominous Bottle
autoominousbottle.msg.off_world: Auto Ominous Bottle: OFF (rejoin or dimension change)
autoominousbottle.config.low_health_disa: Turn the mod off and ring when health drops to the threshold.
autoominousbottle.config.exit_no_bottles: When the bottles run out after a raid, wait 10 seconds and leave the world.
autoominousbottle.msg.no_bottles_exit: Auto Ominous Bottle: out of Ominous Bottles, leaving the world in 10 seconds
subtitles.autoominousbottle.confirm: Auto Ominous Bottle waits for confirmation
autoominousbottle.msg.no_bottles: Auto Ominous Bottle: out of Ominous Bottles!
autoominousbottle.msg.no_food: Auto Ominous Bottle: out of food!
autoominousbottle.msg.drink_failed: Auto Ominous Bottle: the bottle gave no omen twice, auto-drink turned off (Peaceful difficulty?)
autoominousbottle.msg.raid_won: Auto Ominous Bottle: raid won, total %s
